subject: Renewal risk: request for benchmark proofpoints and short PoC
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia@atlasretail.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kenji Sato <kenji@shopwave.jp>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask

Hi Rohan,

Quick note — our procurement and SRE teams have started a parallel evaluation with another provider as part of our renewal conversation (renewal window closes 2026-10-31). Before we get too far down that path, can Redwood provide a short, focused benchmark and a 3-day PoC plan for our checkout inference workload?

What we need to see:
- P50/P95 latency on 128-token sequences and 512-token sequences (our checkout model avg ~220 tokens)
- Throughput at 100ms p95 target and at higher batch settings (we'll share sample traffic)
- Cost delta estimates for Dedicated vs Hosted for our monthly QPS

Kenji is on the thread to coordinate the Japan test region consideration. We'll share a sample dataset (anonymized) if you can confirm S3 ingestion instructions + an NDA/PoC SoW.

Thanks — can you get me a plan and timeline today or tomorrow? This will heavily influence our renewal recommendation.

Best,
Olivia
Director of Engineering, Atlas Retail

---
Attachments: none

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for looping Kenji in.

We take these seriously. I can coordinate a short proof-of-performance (3 business days) that runs your sample checkout traffic through two configuration profiles: Hosted (standard optimizations) and Dedicated (quantized + batching). Grace (CS/POC lead) — can your team run the bench once Atlas uploads their sample to the S3 link?

High level timeline:
- Today: We send a PoC scope + SoW and S3 ingest instructions; sign PoC SoW (DocuSign)
- Tomorrow: Atlas uploads sample; our infra team validates and kicks off smoke tests
- +1 business day: Full run across the two configs, collect latency/throughput and cost model
- Finish: Deliver a one-page decision brief + raw logs for Atlas SREs

Marissa — I may need help on contracting and any renewal incentive conversation.

Olivia/Kenji — can you confirm who will be the technical contact for the upload and whether we can use a temporary test bucket in us-west-2?

Rohan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (proposal stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask — contract & discounts

Looping Stephanie and Ethan here. Stephanie: procurement/discount playbook — Atlas is a mid-enterprise account with an annualized spend target if they commit to Dedicated. They pushed renewal to end-of-month and are evaluating a competitive vendor.

Ethan: because Atlas will share a sample dataset, please confirm the minimum security steps we need (encrypt at rest, temporary creds, audit log note for SOC2 evidence). We may need a short SRA addendum for the PoC.

Action items:
- Stephanie: draft a proposal with 12-month and 24-month committed options + a limited-time renewal credit; include the SLA scope matrix so they see the gap coverage vs competitors.
- Grace: scope the PoC steps and runbook (I put an outline in redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf).
- Ethan: quick note on credential process and required paperwork so we can get Atlas comfortable.

Marissa
Director, Renewal Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf, SLA_scope_matrix.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia@atlasretail.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T14:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask — PoC runbook and measurements

Hi Olivia — thanks. High level PoC plan below and attached is the more detailed runbook. We will keep runs reproducible and hand over the raw traces.

PoC (3 business days) — condensed plan:
1) Day 0 (ingest): Atlas uploads anonymized sample to s3://atlas-data/samples/checkout_100k.parquet. We validate schema, scrub PII, and snapshot the object with temporary read-only creds. (Ethan will confirm creds flow.)
2) Day 1 (baseline): Run 10k synthetic requests to collect baseline p50/p95 at target token lengths on Hosted profile.
3) Day 2 (Dedicated + tuning): Run runs with Dedicated configs: quantized weights, optimized kernels, and batch-size sweep (1..32). Capture throughput at p95 latency buckets (100ms, 200ms, 500ms).
4) Day 3 (analysis + deliverable): Produce a one-page executive brief with charts (latency vs QPS, cost per 1M tokens), raw logs, and config artifacts.

Deliverables:
- Executive brief (PDF)
- Raw traces and run commands (tarball)
- Cost model comparing Hosted vs Dedicated monthly run rates

Attachments referenced: atlas_perf_spec.csv (we'll use this to map the token distribution), redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf (runbook), SLA_scope_matrix.xlsx

Note on security: we will issue temporary STS creds scoped to the object and rotate them after ingest. No data will leave the region unless you request it.

Grace
Senior Customer Success Engineer, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: atlas_perf_spec.csv, redwood_poc_plan_v1.pdf

From: Olivia Grant <olivia@atlasretail.com>

Subject: Re: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask — PoC runbook and measurements

Thanks all — we've uploaded the anonymized sample to the S3 path you listed and shared temporary bucket access with grace@redwood.ai via our IAM team. Link: s3://atlas-data/samples/checkout_100k.parquet

A couple items from procurement: our renewal committee needs to see clear cost delta and a proposed term-based commercial on the delivery. We are looking at two outcomes:
- If Redwood hits the latency/throughput targets and shows >=15% cost savings on Dedicated, we will recommend a 24-month Dedicated commit;
- If not, procurement will move forward with the alternative vendor.

We expect the PoC results by Oct 7 COB. Can you confirm you'll have the executive brief and raw logs ready then?

Olivia

Subject: Re: Atlas renewal / benchmarking ask — commercial options

Quick update from procurement/commercial side before the final brief:

Option A (24-month Dedicated commit)
- Commitment: 24 months dedicated capacity (T-shirt size: M, 4 GPUs)
- Commercial: 18% renewal credit applied to month 1 invoice + 10% list-rate discount across term
- SLA: 99.95% uptime target with financial credits for breaches (see attached SLA matrix)

Option B (12-month blended: hosted + burst Dedicated)
- Commitment: 12 months, hosted primary with 20% burst capacity reserved
- Commercial: 8% renewal credit + performance-based rebate up to 6% if we achieve the p95 latency target at stated QPS

We should align the commercial proposal to the PoC success criteria: if the Dedicated run shows >=15% TCO savings and latency targets met, we recommend Option A. If it's closer, Option B gives them flexibility.

I'll prep the DocuSign for the PoC SoW and a simple term sheet for each option; Marissa, please review before I send.

Stephanie
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
